serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-security-proxy
serverInfo.description: Security proxy for MCP servers — intercepts tool calls, detects prompt injection, masks PII, and writes audit logs. Does not expose a fixed tool set of its own: it forwards (and can transform) whichever tools the wrapped MCP server (configured via PROXY_COMMAND/PROXY_ARGS or a guardbee-proxy.json config file) provides.
